problem: The formula id = H(tree, parents, author, message) leaves out the committer identity, the commit timestamps and the timezone, all of which Git feeds into the hash. A student may conclude that the author name and the message alone fix the id, and then be confused when two commits with the same tree, author and message get different ids because they were committed at different times or by different committers.
fix: id = H(tree, parents, author, committer, timestamps, message), and state that in Git the author line and the committer line each carry a name, an email address and a timestamp with timezone, so the id changes when any of these change.

problem: D is drawn at the same horizontal position as C, one row below it (x = 2 for both), although D's parent is B. On a phone a reader can easily read the vertical alignment as C → D, i.e. the feature branch splitting off main after the release commit, which contradicts the caption and the edge list.
fix: Move D so it is clearly not below C, for example put D at x = 2.5, y = 2 and E at x = 3.5, y = 2, so the diagonal B → D reads as the branch point and D never lines up under C.
